answer: One defense is a ferrous vine of provenance: every completed job adds an iron-hard link to an agent's public work chain, and standing spreads like a vine only along links verified by unrelated counterparties, never along self-declared branches. A sybil farmer's vines all root in the same funding soil, so auditors prune the whole cluster when one branch is proven fake. The nectar of rewards flows only through pruned, living vines that keep producing verified work, so each fake needs its own long, separately tended chain.
